raw_input_bridge: Previous auction volume and previous auction/daily-volume share
economic_hypothesis: Typical auction liquidity persists. Different horizons describe level, change and instability.
evidence_and_caution: Highest rank associations; removing this family causes the largest log-error deterioration.
model_decision: Use the median-20 offset plus regularized corrections.

raw_input_bridge: Trading dates, expiry schedule, session length, month/quarter/year boundaries
economic_hypothesis: Benchmark-related and expiry-related flows may concentrate near known dates.
evidence_and_caution: Calendar ablation has a large deterioration. Binary associations overlap and are not causal effects.

raw_input_bridge: Daily volume, price-volume measure, shares outstanding, absolute returns, bid/ask, high/low/close
economic_hypothesis: Trading capacity, turnover and illiquidity help distinguish normal auction scale and conditions.
evidence_and_caution: Strong isolated volume relationships; liquidity’s extra gain is modest and metric-dependent. The 58-feature finalist beats the 42-feature finalist on the primary criterion.
model_decision: Keep this family, but do not claim every member was independently validated as necessary.

raw_input_bridge: Market cap, shares, coverage/age, cross-sectional size ranks
economic_hypothesis: Scale matters economically, but auction and liquidity history can already encode it.
evidence_and_caution: Strong pooled size association weakens substantially within stock. Extra family adds little in the tested conditional models.
model_decision: No separate family in the selected specification. Shares still enter turnover.

raw_input_bridge: Returns, closing prices, momentum and volatility
economic_hypothesis: Information and risk may influence activity, but signed returns need not align monotonically with unsigned auction volume.
evidence_and_caution: Prior signed raw return is weak and changes annual sign. Family adds little in the tested linear specification.
model_decision: Omit the separate family. Price and absolute-return information still enter liquidity proxies.

raw_input_bridge: Aggregate returns, volume, dispersion, breadth and ranges
economic_hypothesis: Common conditions may affect market-wide or industry-wide demand.
evidence_and_caution: Some univariate associations exist, but tested incremental gains beyond the core are small.
model_decision: Omitted from the parsimonious selected model, not declared economically irrelevant.

raw_input_bridge: Security classifications, dividends, distributions, price adjustment factors
economic_hypothesis: Eligibility and corporate events may affect the share base or trading needs.
evidence_and_caution: Several raw security fields are constant by construction; rare-event associations are not reliable proof of incremental forecast value.
model_decision: Keep source context; separate model family is omitted.
